[Weekly Album Discussion] A Voice Within - Intervals

Good album...pretty nice stuff on here and I enjoyed it, but I much prefer Intervals as an instrumental band. I first heard Intervals from the EP "The Space Between" which absolutely blew me away. I loved that EP. Seeing that they made an album with vocals intrigued me, but also made me apprehensive. Intervals definitely seemed like they should be a clean vocal only band, so I was happy that wish came true. The voice reminded me of radio rock vocalists. which at first turned me off, but I grew to like it. I don't think the singers voice suited the band very well, but its hard to say when they used to be instrumental. Vocal melodies were good and satisfying but still left me wanting more. Instrumentally the album was still very strong. Like Periphery 1, all the songs work very well as instrumentals and do not disappoint. They seemed to be going into a more TesseracT-ish vibe with the instrumental work and less with an Animals as Leaders vibe. Alas, I preferred the Animals as Leaders-ish instrumetal vibe to the vocal album. Still, it's a strong album, but maybe doesn't belong under the name Intervals.

I rate "A Voice Within" a 7/10 and my favorite track is The Self Surrendered

Sub DeleteRowWithContents()
'========================================================================
' DELETES ALL ROWS FROM A2 DOWNWARDS WITH THE WORDs "Record Only" IN COLUMN D
'========================================================================
 Last = Cells(Rows.Count, "D").End(xlUp).Row
 For i = Last To 1 Step -1
 If (Cells(i, "D").Value) = "Record Only" Then
 'Cells(i, "A").EntireRow.ClearContents ' USE THIS TO CLEAR CONTENTS BUT NOT DELETE ROW
 Cells(i, "A").EntireRow.Delete
 End If
 Next i
End Sub

Source

We can modify this to remove all rows that contain empty cells in column P, skipping the first as I assume there will be a header row.

Sub DeleteRow()
'========================================================================
' DELETES ALL ROWS FROM A2 DOWNWARDS WITH EMPTY CELLS IN COLUMN P
'========================================================================
 Last = Cells(Rows.Count, "P").End(xlUp).Row 'Get the last row number in spreadsheet
 For i = Last To 1 Step -1 'Loop N times (Last row number to 1. Not inclusive, so row 2 to N)
 If IsEmpty(Cells(i, "P").Value) Then 'If cell in column P on current row is empty
 Cells(i, "A").EntireRow.Delete 'Delete entire row
 End If
 Next i 'Loop
End Sub

This code can be injected as a macro by pressing Alt+F11 to open the VBA editor. Copy and paste the above modified code into the "This Workbook" module in project explorer on the left hand side of the window. Save the workbook, and then run the macro from the developer toolbar.

File > Options > Customize Ribbon > Tick the box next to "Developer".

Open the "Developer" tab and click "Macros", then select the "DeleteRow" Macro and click "Run".

An alternating current is passed through a coil (which can be wrapped around a core (such as iron)), which generates an alternating magnetic field around said coil. This alternating magnetic field then induces a voltage in the coil of the device as per Faraday's Law. This voltage can be used to charge a battery.
